intended_object: The matrices of the Cartan (coroot) generators h_i (i = 1..6) of the integral Chevalley form of E₆, acting on the 54-dimensional representation V(ϖ₁) ⊕ V(ϖ₆) = V ⊕ V*, with V the 27-dimensional minuscule representation. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the lemma `serreRepresentation_serreH`.
explanation: This is a specific object: the images of the six Cartan generators in one particular 54-dimensional integral representation. The definition is a block-diagonal matrix. The first block is the minuscule Cartan matrix H_i. The second block is −H_i, which is how h_i acts on the contragredient V*. In the dual basis h_i acts by −H_iᵀ, and H_iᵀ = H_i here because the Cartan matrices are diagonal in the weight basis (the module says the contragredient is built by negating them). On V* the weights are negated, which matches. The lemma `serreRepresentation_serreH` proves that this matrix is the image of serreH i under `serreRepresentation`, which is built as a direct sum by `serreLift`. So the definition agrees with the Lie algebra map it is meant to describe. Working over ℤ, with Fin 6 as the index set and Fin 27 ⊕ Fin 27 as the basis, is part of what this object is (an integral Chevalley lattice for E₆), so the definition is not too narrow. Mathlib has no counterpart.
